defaults.prerequisites: Create exact immutable Runs and StepArtifacts from the frozen derivation fixtures.
defaults.action: Call inspect_run through the core dispatcher with the exact Run ID.

rows.requirement: Issue #148: hash raw files from offset zero through EOF
rows.oracle: Independent empty, binary, BOM, LF, CRLF, and trailing-newline SHA-256 vectors match as lowercase hexadecimal.

rows.requirement: Issue #148: hash the fixed Node Context preimage using RFC 8785
rows.oracle: Independent number, UTF-16 property ordering, escaping, Unicode, and normalization-sensitive vectors match.

rows.requirement: Issue #148: include and exclude exactly the settled Node Context factors
rows.oracle: Every factor settled in issue #132 is exercised through the public inspection result.

rows.requirement: Issue #148: select Results and allocate attempts deterministically
rows.oracle: The greatest matching successful attempt is selected and the next attempt follows all committed statuses.

rows.requirement: Issue #148: derive node and Run state
rows.oracle: Complete, runnable, blocked, stale, invalid, incomplete, and complete states follow validated history only.
Every selected Terminal Result is reported in deterministic topology/order, including an empty Markdown Result.

rows.requirement: Issue #148: preserve portable resume while rejecting mutation
rows.oracle: Input and detectable artifact mutation fail integrity; an unchanged whole-project copy has identical derived state regardless of root or Git metadata.
